library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-data-tx is the Micronaut Data transaction abstraction, with no external service to connect to. No extra dependency, Docker image or system property is needed beyond the normal scaffold. I did not open the tx-jdbc test project's user-code-filter.json or test sources, so package-filter guidance is unchecked. The repo's sibling micronaut-data-tx-jdbc:5.1.3 test project has dependencies and no Docker image in its build.gradle, and I did not check that project for a system property. Its extra test dependencies are hikari, h2, micronaut-test-junit5 and the Micronaut annotation processor. Those go beyond micronaut-data-tx itself, and I found nothing here saying they are required.
risks: The library is mostly interfaces and annotations (SynchronousTransactionManager, @Transactional, TransactionOperations). Meaningful coverage may need a Micronaut ApplicationContext and a concrete transaction manager, which this artifact does not provide. If that is needed, the test may have to add micronaut-inject-java as an annotation processor or borrow the tx-jdbc test's dependencies.
That would be a dependency the tests add on their own. It is not a prerequisite the driver has to apply.
